description.content:
The token service, using OAuth 2.0, is responsible for generating and validating an authentication token.
 
Prior to making an API request, a token needs to be generated using your assigned credentials. The token is required prior to making any API call.

Refer to [How To Authenticate](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/how-to-authenticate) for further information.
